depicted_variant: Wujud naga akhir novel dengan tanduk, sisik emas, dan janggut perak, terbang mengitari tiang gerbang gunung.

visual_requirements.description: Naga bertanduk, sisik emas, janggut perak; satu kepala, tanpa sayap atau kepala tambahan.
Terbang dan mulai melingkar pada tiang tinggi; debu dan kain kabut bergerak sebagai konsekuensi geraknya, tanpa energi generik.
Tiang tinggi di gerbang gunung setelah pengangkatan surgawi.

aura: Keagungan hadir dari transformasi naga bertanduk dan sisik emas yang terbang mengitari tiang tinggi (white-dragon-horse-c23).
artistic_choices: Framing dekat kamera rendah memberi dominasi tanpa mengarang tinggi fisik naga akhir novel.
Palet walnut dan emas antik, sinar matahari akhir sebagai cahaya editorial; tekstur batu tua dan sisik.
Detail kaki naga konvensional merupakan interpretasi artistik karena jumlahnya tidak dijabarkan klaim; tidak memakai ikonografi adaptasi populer.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of WHITE DRAGON HORSE, the dragon prince at his final elevation in Journey to the West.
ANATOMY: one serpentine dragon head, prominent horns, GOLD scales over a long coiling body, long SILVER beard; wingless. Four conventional dragon legs only, anatomically connected, two foreclaws visible grasping around a stone pillar; no horse head. [white-dragon-horse-c23]
MOMENT: surging upward into flight and curling around a tall stone pillar at the mountain gate, his massive head foreshortened toward the viewer, eyes intent and noble, beard streaming in movement.
POWER: physical flight and coiling, a dynamic articulated body winding around the pillar, suspended dust disturbed by his motion; no magic glow. [white-dragon-horse-c23]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, tightly framed head and coil dominate nearly the entire square; pillar recedes sharply upward. This is a reverent awesome divine dragon, not a sinister monster.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dying golden sun catches the edges of gold scales and the silver beard; deep walnut shadows and sparse nonluminous mountain haze.
SURFACE: individually layered metallic gold scales with painterly tactile detail, flowing silver whiskers, weathered rough stone.
SETTING: tall pillar at a mountain gate, only fragmentary architecture visible behind the dominant dragon. [white-dragon-horse-c23, white-dragon-horse-c22]
MOOD: awe-inspiring, overwhelming and imposing, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square 1024px or larger, no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: PNG asli dilihat: naga memenuhi bingkai dan tetap agung pada thumbnail; gerak naik dan lilitan tiang terbaca, tanduk/sisik emas/janggut perak c23 jelas. Satu kepala, dua mata, dua cakar depan terlihat, bagian kaki belakang tertutup lilitan; tanpa anggota tambahan terlihat. Semua tujuh Uji Sangar dijawab ya; cahaya matahari editorial, bukan efek kekuatan. Kontak thumbnail asli berukuran200 piksel dilihat ulang bersama13 PNG lane-A; ciri subjek dan kesan sangar/agung tetap terbaca.

root_visual_review.notes: Horned dragon with golden scales and long silver beard coiling round a gate pillar above mountains; one head, no wings.
